summary: NEET 2024 paper leak allegations; compensatory marks to 1563 candidates revoked; re-test conducted; systemic breach assessment: impact on exam integrity, segregation of beneficiaries; grace marks arbitrary; CBI investigation ordered; no evidence of widespread leak; question paper chain of custody verified; no conflict of interest in IIT Madras data analysis; dismissal of writs except grace marks adjustment; counseling stayed pending final order.
final_judgment: Writs partially allowed; grace marks revoked; re-test conducted; counseling process stayed; further investigation by CBI directed.
